items.title: Bitwise, Hyperliquid seek SEC rule changes for token trading, airdrops
items.summary: The firms are seeking clearer guidance on the classification of crypto assets and secondary-market trading as the SEC’s public comment period comes to a close.

items.title: Crypto’s 2026 shutdown wave claims 82 projects. What went wrong?
items.summary: Crypto projects are struggling to survive as falling revenues, depleted funding and security breaches force closures across DeFi, blockchain infrastructure and gaming.

items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: Strive closes $630M SATS IPO, leaves Bitcoin allocation unspecified
items.summary: The Bitcoin treasury company could acquire an estimated 7,372 BTC with its net proceeds, potentially surpassing Metaplanet's holdings if it allocates the full amount.

items.title: Injective, BDACS plan Korean won stablecoin settlement for tokenized assets
items.summary: Injective and BDACS plan to bring won-backed stablecoin KRW1 to tokenized asset markets as South Korea develops a regulatory framework for local currency stablecoins.

items.title: Stablecoin transfers quadruple to $891B as US banks expand adoption: Report
items.summary: Coinbase reports growing adoption by banks and businesses, even as stablecoin market capitalization remains largely unchanged over the past year.

items.title: Wallet Linked to Drift Exploit Sends $61 Million in Ethereum to Tornado Cash
items.summary: The North Korea-linked attacker behind April's $295 million Drift heist pushed 25,700 ETH through the mixer in two hours, and still controls roughly $198 million more.

items.title: Microsoft, Alphabet, Goldman Sachs Join Growing List of Companies Objecting to Tokenized Stocks
items.summary: Sixteen companies have now objected to the OKX-ICE tokenized stock platform proposal as the SEC comment period closes.

items.title: Swiss Regulator Approves First Retail Fund That Holds Bitcoin Directly
items.summary: FINMA waived the diversification rules for the fund but leaned hard on custody and investor-protection safeguards.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs Post Their Best Day in Nearly a Month as BlackRock Does All the Buying
items.summary: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs took in $526.7 million on Monday, their biggest day since Sept. 22. BlackRock's IBIT supplied all of it while Fidelity and Grayscale funds bled.

items.title: Bitcoin's Next Move: Here's What to Watch
items.summary: Bitcoin trades just below $83,000, above both the short-term and long-term moving averages. Here are the levels traders are watching.

items.title: Zcash Leads Crypto Bounce, Surging 8.5% as Bitcoin Reclaims $83,000
items.summary: Zcash jumped 8.5% in 24 hours to $1,215.85 as the broader crypto market rebounded, with Bitcoin up 1.6% and ETF money flowing back in.

items.title: Crypto firms, Wall Street push SEC to revise Regulation Crypto Assets as comments close
items.summary: As the SEC’s comment period on a cryptocurrency proposal draws to a close, digital asset firms and Wall Street institutions have thoughts.

items.title: Utah likens Kalshi to a ‘back-alley gambling den’ in lawsuit naming Susquehanna firms
items.summary: Utah seeks to recover alleged gambling profits and block Kalshi bets across sports, politics and culture.

items.title: JPMorgan issues first long-term bitcoin return forecast, projecting 10% annually
items.summary: J.P. Morgan Asset Management's first long-term bitcoin forecast projects a 10% annual return but flags 55% volatility as a barrier to portfolio adoption.

items.title: Bitcoin yield platform HoneyB developer raises $5 million at $30 million valuation
items.summary: Nectar Group, the developer of bitcoin income platform HoneyB, has raised $5 million in a seed funding round.

items.title: Ethereum staking hits record as yields fall and Solana activity grows: Bitwise
items.summary: A record 43.8 million ETH, nearly 36% of supply, was staked in Q3 as yields fell to 2.63%. Solana staking hit a record 440.5 million SOL.

items.title: OKX is putting its money where its mouth is with new protection plan: Former NY Gov. Cuomo
items.summary: OKX debuted OKX Shield in the U.S. on Tuesday, in what former New York Gov. Andrew Cuomo says is a sign of trust.

items.title: OKX-ICE co-chair Andrew Cuomo calls corporate objections a ‘natural response’ to tokenized stock plans
items.summary: The former NY governor, who co-chairs the joint venture between the crypto exchange and Intercontinental Exchange, said companies were expected to take a wait-and-see approach.

items.title: The Coinbase allegations expose Bitcoin's corporate governance gap
items.summary: Corporate adoption of bitcoin will stall as long as companies can't show who controls the money, who approves its movement, or whether it's still there, argues Onramp CEO Michael Tanguma.

items.title: BlackRock seeks to shield bitcoin investors from losses after rival fund weathers 50% crash
items.summary: BlackRock's proposed fund follows similar products from Calamos that helped investors avoid steep losses during bitcoin's selloff.

items.title: Kazakhstan court bars Coinbase, five others from unlicensed crypto services in Astana International Financial Centre
items.summary: The court injunctions apply strictly to users within the AIFC and do not extend across the rest of Kazakhstan.

items.title: Microsoft, Alphabet and Goldman Sachs join objections to OKX-ICE tokenized stock trading
items.summary: Seven more issuers have opted out of being listed on the planned tokenized stock venue under the SEC's framework, bringing its disclosed objection count to 16.

items.title: France's parliament approves vote to hit stablecoin trades with 31% capital gains tax
items.summary: Amendment I-3898 removes tax deferral for MiCA-compliant stablecoins starting January 2027.
